    (add_sub_cancel_left (L.bal d) (sumOver L.bal (l₁ ++ l₂) + cl))

    (Eq.trans

theorem churn_does_not_depend_on_the_covering (L L' : Ledger A)
    {l₁ : List A} (d₁ : Distinct l₁)
    (hc₁ : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₁)
    (hc₁' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₁)
    {l₂ : List A} (d₂ : Distinct l₂)
    (hc₂ : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₂)
    (hc₂' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₂) :
    sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l₁ - (L.supply - L'.supply)
      = sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l₂ - (L.supply - L'.supply) :=
  congrArg
    (fun f : Accounting L L' => f.burn - (Accounting.normal L L').burn)
    (Accounting.pointwise_indep L L' d₁ hc₁ hc₁' d₂ hc₂ hc₂')

theorem mem_mintPairs_iff (d : A) (v : ℕ) :
    ∀ τ : Trace A, (d, v) ∈ mintPairs τ ↔ Ev.mint d v ∈ τ
  | [] =>
      Iff.intro (fun h => absurd h notMemNil) (fun h => absurd h notMemNil)
  | Ev.mint d' v' :: τ =>
      Iff.intro

          memConsElim h

                (congrArg (fun p : A × ℕ => Ev.mint p.1 p.2) he).symm
                (List.Mem.head τ))

        (fun h =>

            (fun he =>
              Eq.subst (motive := fun p => p ∈ (d', v') :: mintPairs τ)
                (congrArg (fun e : Ev A => (e.site, e.amount)) he).symm
                (List.Mem.head (mintPairs τ)))

              List.Mem.tail (d', v') ((mem_mintPairs_iff d v τ).mpr ht)))

theorem consolidate_acc [inst : DecidableEq A] {L₀ : Ledger A} :
    ∀ (rest : List A) (M : Ledger A) (x : A), M.live = x :: rest →
      NeutralReach L₀ M →
      NeutralReach L₀
        (Ledger.mk [x] (Distinct.cons notMemNil Distinct.nil)
          (fun b => if b = x then M.supply else 0)
          (single_support_bal_live (List.Mem.head []) M.supply))
  | [], M, x, hlv, acc =>
      transport hlv
        (fun b =>
          match inst b x with
          | isTrue hbx =>
              Eq.trans (congrArg M.bal hbx)
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (sumOver M.bal) hlv).symm
                  (if_pos hbx).symm)
          | isFalse hbx =>
              Eq.trans
                (Ledger.bal_eq_zero_of_not_live (L := M)
                  (fun hm =>
                    hbx (eqOfMemSingleton
                      (Eq.subst (motive := fun l => b ∈ l) hlv hm))))
                (if_neg hbx).symm)
        acc
  | y :: rest', M, x, hlv, acc =>
      match Eq.subst (motive := fun l => Distinct l) hlv M.live_distinct with
      | Distinct.cons hxn _ =>
          let hxy : x ≠ y := fun h =>
            hxn (Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ y :: rest') h.symm
              (List.Mem.head rest'))
          let hyx : y ≠ x := fun h => hxy h.symm
          let hx : x ∈ M.live :=
            Eq.subst (motive := fun l => x ∈ l) hlv.symm
              (List.Mem.head (y :: rest'))
          let hy : y ∈ M.live :=
            Eq.subst (motive := fun l => y ∈ l) hlv.symm
              (List.Mem.tail x (List.Mem.head rest'))
          let C := (M.setBal y (M.bal y - M.bal y) hy).setBal x
            ((M.setBal y (M.bal y - M.bal y) hy).bal x + M.bal y) hx
          let r1 : NeutralReach L₀ C :=
            NeutralReach.step y x (M.bal y) hy hx acc rfl
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (fun n => n + M.bal y)
                  (Ledger.xfer_bal_src M y x (M.bal y) hy hx hyx))
                (sub_add_cancel_of_le (Nat.le_refl (M.bal y))))
              (Eq.trans (Ledger.xfer_bal_dst M y x (M.bal y) hy hx)
                (congrArg (fun n => n + M.bal y)
                  (Ledger.setBal_bal_of_ne M y (M.bal y - M.bal y) hy hxy)))
              (fun _a hne =>
                Ledger.xfer_bal_le_of_ne_src M y x (M.bal y) hy hx hne)
              (fun _a hne =>
                Ledger.xfer_bal_le_of_ne_dst M y x (M.bal y) hy hx hne)
          let g : C.bal y = 0 :=
            Eq.trans (Ledger.xfer_bal_src M y x (M.bal y) hy hx hyx)
              (sub_eq_zero_of_le (Nat.le_refl (M.bal y)))
          let D := C.eraseLive y g
          let hliveD : D.live = x :: rest' :=
            Eq.trans (congrArg (eraseOne y) hlv)
              (Eq.trans (eraseOne_cons_neg hxy (y :: rest'))
                (congrArg (fun t => x :: t) (eraseOne_cons_pos rfl rest')))
          let r2 : NeutralReach L₀ D :=
            NeutralReach.shrink y [x] rest' r1 hlv hliveD g (fun _b => rfl)
          let hDsup : D.supply = M.supply :=
            Eq.trans (Ledger.supply_eraseLive C y g)
              (Ledger.supply_xfer M y x (M.bal y) hy hx
                (Nat.le_refl (M.bal y)))
          Eq.subst
            (motive := fun K => NeutralReach L₀ K)
            (congrArg
              (fun s =>
                Ledger.mk [x] (Distinct.cons notMemNil Distinct.nil)
                  (fun b => if b = x then s else 0)
                  (single_support_bal_live (List.Mem.head []) s))
              hDsup)
            (consolidate_acc rest' D x hliveD r2)

theorem process_transaction_effect [DecidableEq A]
    (L₀ : Ledger A) (sender escrow coinbase : A)
    (hse : escrow ≠ sender) (hec : escrow ≠ coinbase)
    (hs₀ : sender ∈ L₀.live) (he₀ : escrow ∈ L₀.live)
    (P R T B : ℕ) (hsplit : R + (T + B) = P) (hP : P ≤ L₀.bal sender)
    (L₂ : Ledger A) (τe : Trace A)
    (hs₂ : sender ∈ L₂.live) (he₂ : escrow ∈ L₂.live) (hc₂ : coinbase ∈ L₂.live)
    (hesc : L₂.bal escrow = L₀.bal escrow + P)
    (hacce : L₂.supply + burned τe
      = ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).setBal escrow
          ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).bal escrow + P) he₀).supply
        + minted τe)
    (hconfe : SiteConfined ([] : List A) [escrow] τe) :
    ∃ (L' : Ledger A) (τ : Trace A),
      τ = τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B]
      ∧ L'.supply + burned τ = L₀.supply + minted τ
      ∧ burned τ = burned τe + B
      ∧ minted τ = minted τe
      ∧ SiteConfined ([] : List A) [escrow] τ
      ∧ L'.supply ≤ L₀.supply
      ∧ L'.bal escrow = L₀.bal escrow
      ∧ L'.live = L₂.live :=
  let e₀ := L₀.bal escrow
  let L₃ := (L₂.setBal escrow (L₂.bal escrow - R) he₂).setBal sender
    ((L₂.setBal escrow (L₂.bal escrow - R) he₂).bal sender + R) hs₂
  let L₄ := (L₃.setBal escrow (L₃.bal escrow - T) he₂).setBal coinbase
    ((L₃.setBal escrow (L₃.bal escrow - T) he₂).bal coinbase + T) hc₂
  let L₅ := L₄.setBal escrow (L₄.bal escrow - B) he₂
  let hR₂ : R ≤ L₂.bal escrow :=
    Eq.subst (motive := fun n => R ≤ n)
      (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => e₀ + n) hsplit) hesc.symm)
      (escrow_guard e₀ R (T + B))
  let e₃ : L₃.bal escrow = e₀ + (T + B) :=
    Eq.trans (Ledger.xfer_bal_src L₂ escrow sender R he₂ hs₂ hse)
      (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n - R) hesc)
        (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => (e₀ + n) - R) hsplit.symm)
          (escrow_after e₀ R (T + B))))
  let hT₃ : T ≤ L₃.bal escrow :=
    Eq.subst (motive := fun n => T ≤ n) e₃.symm (escrow_guard e₀ T B)
  let e₄ : L₄.bal escrow = e₀ + B :=
    Eq.trans (Ledger.xfer_bal_src L₃ escrow coinbase T he₂ hc₂ hec)
      (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n - T) e₃) (escrow_after e₀ T B))
  let hB₄ : B ≤ L₄.bal escrow :=
    Eq.subst (motive := fun n => B ≤ n) e₄.symm (escrow_guard e₀ B 0)
  let e₅ : L₅.bal escrow = e₀ :=
    Eq.trans (Ledger.setBal_bal_self L₄ escrow (L₄.bal escrow - B) he₂)
      (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n - B) e₄) (escrow_after e₀ B 0))
  let c₅ :=
    Ledger.supply_acc_trans
      (Ledger.supply_acc_trans
        (Ledger.supply_acc_trans
          (Ledger.supply_acc_trans
            (Ledger.acc_xfer L₀ sender escrow P hs₀ he₀ hP) hacce)
          (Ledger.acc_xfer L₂ escrow sender R he₂ hs₂ hR₂))
        (Ledger.acc_xfer L₃ escrow coinbase T he₂ hc₂ hT₃))
      (Ledger.acc_burn L₄ escrow B he₂ hB₄)
  let hbτ : burned (τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B]) = (0 + burned τe) + B :=
    Eq.trans (burned_append τe [Ev.burn escrow B])
      (congrArg (fun n => n + B) (Nat.zero_add (burned τe)).symm)
  let hmτ : minted (τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B]) = 0 + minted τe :=
    Eq.trans (minted_append τe [Ev.burn escrow B])
      (Nat.zero_add (minted τe)).symm
  let hacc : L₅.supply + burned (τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B])
      = L₀.supply + minted (τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B]) :=
    Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => L₅.supply + n) hbτ)
      (Eq.trans c₅ (congrArg (fun n => L₀.supply + n) hmτ.symm))
  let hconf : SiteConfined ([] : List A) [escrow] (τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B]) :=
    SiteConfined.append hconfe (SiteConfined.burn ([] : List A) escrow B)
  ⟨L₅, τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B],
   rfl, hacc,
   Eq.trans hbτ (congrArg (fun n => n + B) (Nat.zero_add (burned τe))),
   Eq.trans hmτ (Nat.zero_add (minted τe)),
   hconf,
   supply_le_of_confined_no_mint hacc hconf,
   ⟨e₅, rfl⟩⟩

theorems.proof_source:
theorem process_transaction_of_reach [DecidableEq A]
    (L₀ : Ledger A) (sender escrow coinbase : A)
    (hse : escrow ≠ sender) (hec : escrow ≠ coinbase)
    (hs₀ : sender ∈ L₀.live) (he₀ : escrow ∈ L₀.live) (hc₀ : coinbase ∈ L₀.live)
    (P R T B : ℕ) (hsplit : R + (T + B) = P) (hP : P ≤ L₀.bal sender)
    (L₂ : Ledger A)
    (hexec : XferReach
      ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).setBal escrow
        ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).bal escrow + P) he₀) L₂)
    (hescE : L₂.bal escrow
      = ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).setBal escrow
          ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).bal escrow + P)
          he₀).bal escrow) :
    ∃ (L' : Ledger A) (τ : Trace A),
      τ = ([] : Trace A) ++ [Ev.burn escrow B]
      ∧ L'.supply + burned τ = L₀.supply + minted τ
      ∧ burned τ = burned ([] : Trace A) + B
      ∧ minted τ = minted ([] : Trace A)
      ∧ SiteConfined ([] : List A) [escrow] τ
      ∧ L'.supply ≤ L₀.supply
      ∧ L'.bal escrow = L₀.bal escrow
      ∧ L'.live = L₂.live :=
  let hlive : L₂.live = L₀.live := hexec.live_eq
  let hs₂ : sender ∈ L₂.live :=
    Eq.subst (motive := fun l => sender ∈ l) hlive.symm hs₀
  let he₂ : escrow ∈ L₂.live :=
    Eq.subst (motive := fun l => escrow ∈ l) hlive.symm he₀
  let hc₂ : coinbase ∈ L₂.live :=
    Eq.subst (motive := fun l => coinbase ∈ l) hlive.symm hc₀
  let hacce : L₂.supply + burned ([] : Trace A)
      = ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).setBal escrow
          ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).bal escrow + P)
          he₀).supply + minted ([] : Trace A) :=
    congrArg (fun n => n + 0) hexec.supply_eq
  let hesc : L₂.bal escrow = L₀.bal escrow + P :=
    Eq.trans hescE (prepay_bal_escrow L₀ sender escrow hse hs₀ he₀ P)
  process_transaction_effect L₀ sender escrow coinbase hse hec hs₀ he₀
    P R T B hsplit hP L₂ ([] : Trace A) hs₂ he₂ hc₂ hesc hacce
    (SiteConfined.nil ([] : List A) [escrow])

        (Ledger.supply_acc_chain Ls (fun _ => 0) (fun i => k * gs i) h n))

theorem process_transaction_destroy_effect [DecidableEq A]
    (L₀ : Ledger A) (sender escrow coinbase : A)
    (hse : escrow ≠ sender) (hec : escrow ≠ coinbase)
    (hs₀ : sender ∈ L₀.live) (he₀ : escrow ∈ L₀.live)
    (P R T B : ℕ) (hsplit : R + (T + B) = P) (hP : P ≤ L₀.bal sender)
    (L₂ : Ledger A) (τe : Trace A)
    (hs₂ : sender ∈ L₂.live) (he₂ : escrow ∈ L₂.live) (hc₂ : coinbase ∈ L₂.live)
    (hesc : L₂.bal escrow = L₀.bal escrow + P)
    (hacce : L₂.supply + burned τe
      = ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).setBal escrow
          ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).bal escrow + P) he₀).supply
        + minted τe)
    (hconfe : SiteConfined ([] : List A) [escrow] τe)
    (a : A) (ha₂ : a ∈ L₂.live) :
    ∃ (L'' : Ledger A) (τ' : Trace A) (D : ℕ),
      τ' = (τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B]) ++ [Ev.burn a D]
      ∧ L''.supply + burned τ' = L₀.supply + minted τ'
      ∧ burned τ' = (burned τe + B) + D
      ∧ minted τ' = minted τe
      ∧ SiteConfined ([] : List A) [escrow, a] τ'
      ∧ L''.supply ≤ L₀.supply
      ∧ a ∉ L''.live :=
  match process_transaction_effect L₀ sender escrow coinbase hse hec hs₀ he₀
      P R T B hsplit hP L₂ τe hs₂ he₂ hc₂ hesc hacce hconfe with
  | ⟨L', τ, hτ, hacc, hb, hm, hconf, _hle, _hesc, hlv⟩ =>
      let haL' : a ∈ L'.live :=
        Eq.subst (motive := fun s => a ∈ s) hlv.symm ha₂
      let hbτ' : burned (τ ++ [Ev.burn a (L'.bal a)]) = burned τ + L'.bal a :=
        burned_append τ [Ev.burn a (L'.bal a)]
      let hmτ' : minted (τ ++ [Ev.burn a (L'.bal a)]) = minted τ :=
        minted_append τ [Ev.burn a (L'.bal a)]
      let hacc' :
          ((L'.setBal a 0 haL').eraseLive a
              (Ledger.destroy_guard L' a haL')).supply
            + burned (τ ++ [Ev.burn a (L'.bal a)])
          = L₀.supply + minted (τ ++ [Ev.burn a (L'.bal a)]) :=
        Eq.trans
          (congrArg
            (fun n => ((L'.setBal a 0 haL').eraseLive a
              (Ledger.destroy_guard L' a haL')).supply + n) hbτ')
          (Eq.trans
            (Ledger.supply_acc_trans hacc (Ledger.acc_destroy L' a haL'))
            (congrArg (fun n => L₀.supply + n) hmτ'.symm))
      let hconf' : SiteConfined ([] : List A) [escrow, a]
          (τ ++ [Ev.burn a (L'.bal a)]) :=
        SiteConfined.append
          (SiteConfined.mono (fun _x hx => hx)
            (fun _x hx => memAppendLeft [escrow] [a] hx) hconf)
          (SiteConfined.mono (fun _x hx => hx)
            (fun _x hx => memAppendRight [escrow] [a] hx)
            (SiteConfined.burn ([] : List A) a (L'.bal a)))
      ⟨(L'.setBal a 0 haL').eraseLive a (Ledger.destroy_guard L' a haL'),
       τ ++ [Ev.burn a (L'.bal a)], L'.bal a,
       congrArg (fun t => t ++ [Ev.burn a (L'.bal a)]) hτ,
       hacc',
       Eq.trans hbτ' (congrArg (fun n => n + L'.bal a) hb),
       Eq.trans hmτ' hm,
       hconf',
       supply_le_of_confined_no_mint hacc' hconf',
       Ledger.destroy_notMem L' a haL'⟩

    (hmem : ∀ i : ℕ, as i ∈ (Ls i).live)
    (hnext : ∀ i : ℕ, (Ls (i + 1)).supply

          (Ledger.destroy_guard (Ls i) (as i) (hmem i))).supply) :
    ∀ n : ℕ,

  fun n =>
    Eq.trans
      (Ledger.supply_acc_chain Ls (fun i => (Ls i).bal (as i)) (fun _ => 0)

    (hc₂e : coinbase ∈ L₂e.live)

      hc₂E).supply

          hs₂e).setBal escrow
            ((((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).setBal sender
              ((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).bal sender + R)
              hs₂e).bal escrow) - T) he₂e).setBal coinbase
          (((((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).setBal sender
            ((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).bal sender + R)
            hs₂e).setBal escrow
              ((((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).setBal sender
                ((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).bal sender + R)
                hs₂e).bal escrow) - T) he₂e).bal coinbase) + T) hc₂e).setBal
        escrow
        ((((((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).setBal sender
          ((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).bal sender + R)
          hs₂e).setBal escrow
            ((((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).setBal sender
              ((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).bal sender + R)
              hs₂e).bal escrow) - T) he₂e).setBal coinbase
          (((((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).setBal sender
            ((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).bal sender + R)
            hs₂e).setBal escrow

                ((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).bal sender + R)

theorems.proof_source:
theorem admission_iff_guards [DecidableEq A] (L₀ : Ledger A) (sender escrow : A)
    (hse : escrow ≠ sender) (hs₀ : sender ∈ L₀.live) (he₀ : escrow ∈ L₀.live)
    (P value : ℕ) :
    P + value ≤ L₀.bal sender
    ↔ P ≤ L₀.bal sender
      ∧ value ≤ ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).setBal escrow
          ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).bal escrow + P)
          he₀).bal sender :=
  let hpre := prepay_bal_sender L₀ sender escrow hse hs₀ he₀ P
  Iff.intro
    (fun h =>
      ⟨((guard_split_iff (L₀.bal sender) P value).mp h).left,
       Eq.subst (motive := fun n => value ≤ n) hpre.symm
         ((guard_split_iff (L₀.bal sender) P value).mp h).right⟩)
    (fun h =>
      (guard_split_iff (L₀.bal sender) P value).mpr
        ⟨h.left, Eq.subst (motive := fun n => value ≤ n) hpre h.right⟩)

theorem exact_supply_on (L L' : Ledger A) (l : List A) (dl : Distinct l)
    (hcov : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l)
    (hcov' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l) :
    L'.supply + sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l
      = L.supply + sumOver (fun a => L'.bal a - L.bal a) l :=
  let hL : L.supply = sumOver L.bal l :=
    sumOver_eq_of_support_iff L.bal L.live_distinct dl
      (fun a hne => Iff.intro (fun _ => hcov a hne) (fun _ => L.bal_live a hne))
  let hL' : L'.supply = sumOver L'.bal l :=
    sumOver_eq_of_support_iff L'.bal L'.live_distinct dl
      (fun a hne =>
        Iff.intro (fun _ => hcov' a hne) (fun _ => L'.bal_live a hne))
  Eq.trans
    (congrArg (fun n => n + sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l) hL')
    (Eq.trans (sumOver_add L'.bal (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l).symm
      (Eq.trans (sumOver_congr (fun a => add_sub_symm (L'.bal a) (L.bal a)) l)
        (Eq.trans (sumOver_add L.bal (fun a => L'.bal a - L.bal a) l)
          (congrArg (fun n => n + sumOver (fun a => L'.bal a - L.bal a) l)
            hL.symm))))
